blockers: Actual execution was prohibited by the read-only brief; no payment challenge was signed or paid, so paid image fulfillment remains untested.
Execution requires an image prompt and a funded x402 Base-USDC or MPP Tempo-USDC wallet.
trust_events: Caution: [Verisign RDAP](https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1/domain/DRIFTFLIGHT.COM) reports the domain was registered on 2026-07-16, while the site's terms claim an effective date of 2026-06-01; exact-name searches found no verifiable independent company footprint.

I would limit any initial transaction to the minimum price until fulfillment and the seller are verified. Customer logos and testimonials are unlinked, and the site provides no business address or general support contact.
notes: Driftflight's primary product is API-based text-to-image generation. The authoritative [live manifest](https://agents.driftflight.com/manifest.json) showed acceptingOrders=true and pay-as-you-go prices of $0.01/sketch image, $0.06/studio image, and $0.14/gallery image; prepaid credit has a $1 minimum at the same rates, and a Sketch Monthly plan costs $5/month. Storefront purchases include a commercial license; failed renders are not billed, and hosted output URLs remain available for 90 days. The concrete machine path is POST /v1/images/generate through agents.driftflight.com, receive a priced HTTP 402, settle it programmatically using x402 or MPP, retry with signed payment proof, and receive the image URL. Per the [agent guide](https://agents.driftflight.com/llms-full.txt), paid pay-as-you-go requires no account, API key, email confirmation, CAPTCHA, KYC, or sales call. The three-free-sketch trial does require a human-claimed agent identity with verified email, but that gate is avoidable via the paid path. End-to-end autonomous purchase therefore appears technically possible with a funded compatible wallet, although fulfillment was not tested under the recon-only restriction.
